evez-cheat-codes 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Unlocks comprehensive cheat codes and hidden features for OpenClaw power users.
- Documents enabling secret HTTP API endpoints, advanced debugging, and diagnostic environment variables.
- Reveals admin HTTP RPC, raw tool invocation routes, and in-chat debug commands.
- Includes agent-specific configuration shortcuts for session compaction, context injection, and “dreaming” (memory consolidation) options.
- Provides copy-paste config snippets and command examples for fast setup.
